g.text: 1 Rinse the burette with titrant, fill it, and run
some through the tip to clear air bubbles.
2 Record the initial reading to 0.01 mL.
3 Pipette 25.00 mL of acid into the flask, add
two drops of phenolphthalein, start the stirrer.
4 Add titrant quickly at first, then dropwise as the
colour begins to linger; stop at the first
5 Record the final reading; the titre is the
initial 0.00 mL, final 25.00 mL, titre 25.00 mL
Lengths are drawn to scale (1 mm = 0.62 px); tube widths are enlarged.

g.text: TITRATION APPARATUS: A 50 ML BURETTE DELIVERING TITRANT INTO A STIRRED FLASK, WITH THE MAIN DIMENSIONS
